label: rem:local-cohomology-group-remark
title: Local cohomology as an extension obstruction
html: The local cohomology group H^1_{\mathfrak{m}_1}(A) measures the algebraic obstruction to extending sections across the defect at z = 1. In this non-commutative setting, the derived category framework generalizes the commutative concept of principal parts supported at the singularity.
heading: Remark
